Question: How many orders contain items from more than one seller?
text:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
) AS multi_seller_orders;
```
Counts the distinct orders that have order items linked to two or more different sellers.
